title: Seeking Volunteers for Advisory Board & Committee Positions - NewsBreak
text:
2 days ago The following boards have terms expiring April 30, 2026, or have ongoing vacancies. The City of Kalispell is looking for volunteers to serve on these advisory boards. Applications must be received by April 10, 2026, for full consideration; however, applications are taken year-round. Fill out an online application to be considered. Visit board web pages for more information about each board. Please contact the Kalispell City Clerk at (406) 758-7756, cityclerk@kalispell.com with any questions or concerns. Read full article
